public_policy_brief:
The review covers the statement forecasts and ratios, agency Financial schedule, social-venture return outcomes, selected registry 10% income statement, wind Presentation, DCF valuation and diagnostic displays, Budget Summary, and regional-meeting financial schedules. Other scenarios and supporting schedules are supplied context; the businesses retain their separate units and periods. Preserve supplied inputs, context and unaffected values.

The agency GCI-to-net-income calculation is the supplied planning heuristic; its buyer-appointment branch is outside this review. Use the numeric attendee grid for the regional meeting; its standalone conference statement is an alternative, not an additional component. The DCF incremental-return diagnostic uses the change in annual NOPAT through year 10 per total capital added in years 1-10; annual ROIC uses beginning-of-year capital.
